methods.name: jax.pmap
methods.description: Primitive used to parallelize and scale code across an arbitrary number of GPUs by broadcasting global gradient signals to update local model parameters at each gradient descent iteration

methods.name: Causal training for PINNs
methods.description: A training algorithm for PINNs summarizing a re-formulation of the residual and initial conditions loss, an annealing scheme for the ϵ parameter, and a stopping criterion terminating training upon convergence of temporal weights wi.

methods.name: causal training strategy
methods.description: A training strategy respecting temporal causality within time windows, serving as an enhancement to time-marching approaches.

methods.name: time-marching or curriculum training strategies
methods.description: Strategies respecting temporal causality by learning the solution sequentially within separate time-windows.

methods.name: PINNs
methods.description: Physics-Informed Neural Networks used to solve problems exhibiting sensitivity to initial data and strong spatio-temporal correlations.

methods.name: Modified multi-layer perceptrons
methods.description: A neural network architecture proposed by Wang et al. designed to outperform conventional MLPs.

methods.name: synchronous data-parallelism
methods.description: Data-parallel training across multiple GPUs where each device stores an identical copy of trainable parameters, generates batches of spatial and temporal points independently, and aggregates training loss gradients via a collective reduce-mean operation.

methods.name: Taylor-mode automatic differentiation
methods.description: Accelerates the computation of high-order derivatives by leveraging a truncated Taylor polynomial approximation of function compositions via the Faà di Bruno formula.

methods.name: physics-informed neural network
methods.description: Model trained to solve the Allen-Cahn equation using Algorithm 1 with temporal residual loss minimization.

methods.name: weighted residual loss
methods.description: Loss formulation utilizing temporal weights {wi} that activate and converge to 1 as the PDE residual loss is minimized, sensitive to a causality parameter ϵ.

methods.name: residual weights stopping criterion
methods.description: Convergence assessment method that terminates training when min_i wi > δ for a threshold parameter δ ∈ (0, 1).

methods.name: annealing strategy for adjusting ϵ
methods.description: Gradually increases the strength with which the PDE residual constraint is enforced using an increasing sequence of values {ϵi}k i=1 to avoid tedious hyper-parameter tuning.

methods.name: Fitting the initial data
methods.description: Treats the initial loss Lic as a special temporal residual at t=0 and incorporates it into the weighted residual loss.
